reserves.name: USDC, PYUSD, and XPAX stablecoin reserve basket

reserveReview.rationale: XPR Network identifies XMD as a reserve-backed stablecoin index treasury with 1:1 minting and redemption using USDC, PYUSD, and XPAX. It does not publish basket weights, current balances, or any evidence that supports the former 34/33/33 split, so the reserve is represented as one unweighted complete basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: XPR Network issuer disclosure of the complete three-stablecoin XMD basket
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The constituent stablecoins are disclosed, but the issuer does not publish their current weights, reserve balances, or a dated proof-of-reserves report.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: USDC, PYUSD, and XPAX stablecoin reserve basket
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: USDC, PYUSD, and XPAX are identified, but no current percentage allocation is published.

providers.name: Metal Dollar reserve treasury (not publicly identified)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed issuer overview identifies the stablecoin basket but does not disclose the reserve custodian, account segregation, insolvency treatment, rehypothecation, or provider shares.
